description: This file defines models, interfaces, and utility functions for configuring and managing table widgets within the Thingsboard UI, including entity data handling, column configurations, styling, and action descriptors.

methods.name: entityDataSortOrderFromString
methods.description: Converts a string representation of sort order into an EntityDataSortOrder object, based on columns.

methods.name: findColumnByEntityKey
methods.description: Finds a column in the columns array matching the given EntityKey.

methods.name: findEntityKeyByColumnDef
methods.description: Retrieves the EntityKey associated with a column definition.

methods.name: findColumn
methods.description: Finds a column in the columns array based on a property and value.

methods.name: findColumnByName
methods.description: Finds a column by its name.

methods.name: findColumnByLabel
methods.description: Finds a column by its label, prioritizing alarm columns.

methods.name: findColumnByDef
methods.description: Finds a column by its definition string.

methods.name: findColumnProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a specific property value from a column matching search criteria.

methods.name: toEntityKey
methods.description: Converts a column definition to its label (entity key).

methods.name: toEntityColumnDef
methods.description: Converts a label to its column definition.

methods.name: fromEntityColumnDef
methods.description: Retrieves label from a column definition.

methods.name: toAlarmColumnDef
methods.description: Converts a name to its alarm column definition.

methods.name: fromAlarmColumnDef
methods.description: Retrieves name from an alarm column definition.

methods.name: getEntityValue
methods.description: Gets the value of an entity property based on a DataKey.

methods.name: getAlarmValue
methods.description: Gets the value of an alarm property based on a DataKey.

methods.name: getRowStyleInfo
methods.description: Returns an observable with row style function info, compiling if necessary.

methods.name: getCellStyleInfo
methods.description: Returns an observable with cell style function info, compiling if necessary.

methods.name: getCellContentFunctionInfo
methods.description: Returns an observable with cell content function info, compiling if necessary.

methods.name: getColumnWidth
methods.description: Returns the width setting for a column.

methods.name: widthStyle
methods.description: Creates a style object for a given width.

methods.name: getColumnDefaultVisibility
methods.description: Determines if a column should be visible by default, considering mobile context.

methods.name: getColumnSelectionAvailability
methods.description: Checks if column selection is enabled based on settings.

methods.name: getTableCellButtonActions
methods.description: Retrieves action descriptors for cell buttons, compiling functions as needed.

methods.name: checkHasActions
methods.description: Checks if any cell button actions have icons, indicating actions are present.

methods.name: prepareTableCellButtonActions
methods.description: Filters and prepares cell button actions for display, reserving space if needed.

methods.name: filterTableCellButtonAction
methods.description: Determines if a cell button action should be shown based on its showAction function.

methods.name: noDataMessage
methods.description: Returns a localized message for no data, using custom translation if provided.

methods.name: constructTableCssString
methods.description: Builds CSS string for table styling based on widget config colors.

methods.name: getHeaderTitle
methods.description: Returns the header title, using custom title if specified.

methods.name: buildPageStepSizeValues
methods.description: Generates an array of page size options based on count and increment.

methods.name: isValidPageStepIncrement
methods.description: Checks if a page step increment is a positive integer.

methods.name: isValidPageStepCount
methods.description: Checks if a page step count is a positive integer up to 100.
